A Linux-first system cleanup and inspection tool

Usage: mole-linux [OPTIONS] [PATH] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  analyze     Analyze disk usage at PATH
  status      Show system status
  snapshots   List Btrfs and Snapper snapshots without changing them
  clean       Clean supported caches
  purge       Purge development artifacts
  installer   Find installer files
  uninstall   Uninstall applications
  optimize    Optimize the system
  history     Show operation history
  completion  Generate shell completion
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [PATH]  Path to analyze when no subcommand is provided

Options:
      --debug    Enable debug output
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
